name: Krabi Airport to Koh Lanta

seo.title: Krabi Airport to Koh Lanta Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
seo.metaDescription: Private minivan taxi between Krabi Airport (KBV) and Koh Lanta, both directions, door to door. Cash to the driver, no prepayment. Price on WhatsApp.

h1: Krabi Airport to Koh Lanta, private minivan taxi
lead: Door to door between Krabi Airport (KBV) and your hotel on Koh Lanta, in either direction. Your group only, no sharing.

facts.label: Drive time
facts.value: About 2 to 3 hours, depending on traffic

facts.label: Pickup and drop-off
facts.value: Krabi Airport (KBV), Your hotel on Koh Lanta

faq.q: Where does the driver meet me at Krabi Airport?
faq.a: At the time you give us, at the airport. Send your flight number and the team confirms the meeting point on WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can I book the transfer back to Krabi Airport?
faq.a: Yes. Enter your hotel as the pickup and Krabi Airport as the destination, with your date and pickup time.

photos.alt: Minivan interior with diamond-stitched tan leather seats and a lit ceiling
photos.shot: Real photo of the VIP Taxi Lanta minivan, shared by every route page today: one photo per route later if possible.
Where the driver meets you at Krabi Airport (arrivals exit, sign with the client's name), no faces needed.

legacyText.title: Krabi Airport to Koh Lanta Minivan Taxi | VIP Taxi Lanta
body: Give us your flight number and landing time, your hotel on Koh Lanta and the number of people. The team confirms the price on WhatsApp and the driver waits for you at the airport.
For the way back, enter your hotel as the pickup and Krabi Airport as the destination, with the time you want to leave.
